name: Your Beloved Magical Girl Made a Big Mess and Needs Help to Clean It Up: Magical Girl Tidy Up
summary: Saving the world creates a lot of mess, so Magical Girls need some help. In this Anime meets Tidy Up game, you organize chaotic rooms and chat with the heroines. Improve your bonds to unlock magic and discover captivating stories.
